details: US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced their most significant weekly inflows of 2026, collectively attracting $2.6 billion through August 21. Bitcoin ETFs alone drew $1.918 billion, while Ethereum funds secured $697.2 million. This surge in institutional demand coincides with a sharp rally in the cryptocurrency market, with Bitcoin nearing $80,000 and Ethereum surpassing $2,500.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs See Record Inflows in Strongest Week of 2026

details: The US Treasury's decision to increase buybacks of long-dated government bonds has contributed to a decrease in borrowing costs. This move typically benefits riskier assets such as Bitcoin, playing a role in its recent price appreciation. However, Federal Reserve officials have underscored their commitment to an independent monetary policy focused on controlling inflation and supporting the labor market, suggesting a potential divergence in objectives if the Treasury's actions ease financial conditions excessively.
title: US Treasury Bond Buybacks Boost Risky Assets; Fed Wary of Inflation Impact

details: Financial markets are closely monitoring global central bank actions, with expectations building for a potential interest rate hike from the Bank of Japan in September due to inflation concerns. Similarly, a further rate increase from the European Central Bank (ECB) is largely priced in by markets. The upcoming Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, particularly the keynote speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, will be a critical event for insights into the Federal Reserve's ongoing strategy to combat inflation amidst signs of moderating US economic growth.
title: Global Central Banks Hint at Tightening; Jackson Hole Key for Fed Outlook
